rule: Distinguish requirements for establishing the synthesis theory from requirements for a new general law or new morphology.

synthesis_theory.question: Are the definitions and axioms internally coherent and non-circular?
Do major parent theories embed as special cases/modules without changing GMI definitions?
blockers: verify each reduction against primary source statement

synthesis_theory.question: Do materially different machine-intelligence forms instantiate the same morphology/state/resource schema?
Are core profile/dominance/amortization/developmental-capital definitions executable and exact on reference cases?

new_general_law.question: Can pre-outcome structure predict later developmental burden within a nontrivial family on held-out tasks?
Does one compact predictor/invariant transfer across materially different morphology families beyond their native parent predictors?
Can a prospectively derived morphology/frontier phase transition be recovered endogenously from a neutral candidate space?

new_morphology.question: Can a theory-predicted parent-frontier hole be filled by a non-parent-equivalent morphology?
new_morphology.unlock: prospective obstruction/headroom region against strongest known/hybrid parents

recursive_improvement.question: Does the burden to discover verified frontier improvements decline across genuine fresh generations under a fixed constitution?

important_boundary: Failure of E1/E2/E5 does not automatically invalidate the synthesis theory; it means the synthesis may remain a metrology/formal integration framework rather than a new cross-paradigm law.
